t2.thesis: FLEX has fallen sharply into the print (about -32% over 1m, with an implied move near 18%) and has missed the entry-to-exit open window in 3 of its last 4 reports despite EPS beats, so the odds of a rise sit slightly below even.
reasons: Entry-open to exit-open on a BMO print captures only the overnight gap, and the last 4 gaps were -9%, +29%, -3.5% and -9% (win rate 25%) even though EPS beat every time.

The stock is down 52% from its 52w high and 32% over 1m, which suggests de-risking over the spin-off financing and debt load. That cuts both ways: a depressed base can bounce on a decent print, but the pre-print weakness has not reversed yet.
Estimates have been revised up by about 5.6% over 90 days with a high bar and 10 analysts at a 1.27 mean rec, so expectations are elevated and a beat is likely already priced in.
Leverage is rising: about $4.4B for EPC Power, $1.1B in bridge debt, and the Axiom spin-off. The market is focused on financial risk, with an Oct 13 drop of 6.9%.
The wide implied move of 18% and the call-over-put IV spread are roughly neutral for direction.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether the Q3 guide and the AI/CPI segment commentary justify the raised FY guide and calm worries about spin-off leverage and free cash flow (Q1 FCF was weak at $41M).
